meta.ownerNote: This is the only file the map page reads. It is read at build time by src/pages/wardogs-map.mjs and also served as-is at /assets/data/wardogs-map-points.json. Add a location by copying the shape of `template` into `points`. Never guess: if a position has not been read, leave x and y as null and the page will print the row as 'position not read yet' instead of plotting it.
meta.fieldNote: x and y are kilometres. x counts east from the west edge, y counts south from the north edge, so both run 0-16 on every map. gridRef is the lettered 1 km cell: columns A-P west to east, rows 1-16 north to south.

template.name: Name exactly as the game prints it
template.note: What it is, in one line. Leave out anything you did not read.

confidenceValues: official - printed by Bulkhead, Team17 or Valve

our-reading - arithmetic or a convention we chose, said out loud

grid.rowDirection: rows are numbered down the map, 1 at the north edge

maps.name: Bakurani
maps.summary: River valley. A town on the valley floor, forested ridges either side, one sustained road across it.

source.label: wardogshub.gg interactive maps, three maps of 256 km2 named Bakurani, Ozeti and Zestafona

maps.name: Ozeti
maps.summary: Hill town. Low buildings along one road, a walled stadium, a church on the high ground, orchard and dry fields around it.

maps.name: Zestafona
maps.summary: Arid high country. Irrigated field blocks along a creek, scattered settlement, bare rock and low scrub on the ridges.

features.name: Control Zone
features.note: 2 x 2 km, randomised somewhere inside the 256 km2 map every match, so it has no fixed position. Drag the square to where your match put it.

source.label: Bulkhead, WARDOGS - TOP QUESTIONS, Steam news, 18 February 2026

features.name: Hot Zone
features.note: A shifting sub-zone inside the Control Zone. Players inside count double and earn double cash. No diameter has been published, so none is printed here.
